ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Volume Shadow Copy Vssapi.dll Load
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the image load of VSS DLL by uncommon executables Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\vssapi\\\.dll$") AND  NOT (((process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\explorer\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\ImmersiveControlPanel\\SystemSettings\.exe") OR (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\\\{") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\"))) OR (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\")) OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\Package\\ Cache\\\\"))
